_doc: PERMANENT Forge agent registry (user decision 2026-07-05). These names are FIXED across every project — never invent new/random agent names for work these roles cover. Extra agents are allowed ONLY with: permanent standardized name + clear role + default skill bundle + suitable model assignment + self-review duty + a place in the Boss→Head Chef→QA loop (add them HERE, template-first, then sync). Runtime note (honest): agents run as Claude Code subagents (Agent tool); 'claudeTier' is the runtime model. NVIDIA models are called AS TOOLS by agents via forge-bin/nvidia-provider.cjs per agent-model-map.json.
_wp15_note: WP 1.5 (2026-10-24): LEGACY MIRROR. The agent .md frontmatter is now the single source of truth for every per-agent fact; .claude/config/agents/agents.generated.json is generated from it (node .claude/forge-bin/forge-registry-gen.cjs agents --write) and forge-doctor `agents` cross-checks this file against it. This file stays, kept consistent, until a later wave removes it: change the agent frontmatter first, then this mirror, then regenerate. Cross-checked here: Boss vs specialist placement and agentFile.
loop: User → Boss (mission) → Head Chef (exact work packages) → Skill Boss (skills attached) + model routing check → subagents (each self-reviews before done) → Test Boss (automated tests) → UI Boss (visual, when relevant) → SEO Boss (perf/site, when relevant) → Security Boss → Review Boss (final QA) → fail? structured failure report → Boss → Head Chef assigns fixes → re-test → Review Boss again → repeat until genuine pass or truthful blocker.

boss.name: Boss
boss.responsibilities: GOAT 2026-10-06: the deep-route mission owner (opus · xhigh), dispatched only for mission planning or deep work packages. The main session is the Lead/sonnet router and Head Chef does triage; each package's model comes from the triage route plus the one-step escalation ladder, not from Boss. Owns the mission it is given: split into work packages, track, receive QA failure reports, decide the fix strategy and reassign ONCE (more effort first, then a bigger model); a second FAIL stops and is reported to the owner. Final owner of quality.

head-chef.name: Head Chef
head-chef.responsibilities: Convert Boss instructions into exact step-by-step work packages; verify every subagent completed its goal; prevent random/duplicate work; ensure each task has the correct agent + skill bundle + model; send unclear/failed work back to Boss. GOAT triage (2026-10-06): adds {route: quick|build|deep, risk: low|medium|high, checks[]} to every work package (routes in FORGE_MODEL_ROUTING.json) and reads/writes the one-line routing lessons in .claude/agent-memory/head-chef/MEMORY.md.

review-boss.name: Review Boss
review-boss.responsibilities: End-of-project review vs the user goal: design, code quality, logic, security, tests, UX, edge cases, missing features; structured failure report to Boss; never approve until genuinely good; strong review model required.

test-boss.name: Test Boss
test-boss.responsibilities: Websites/apps: Playwright — buttons, forms, links, menus, modals, filters, flows, mobile nav, keyboard/loading/error states, many interaction checks (not one happy path). Other project types: the correct automated test strategy. Produce real test proof + failures.

ui-boss.name: UI Boss
ui-boss.responsibilities: Premium, professional, unique, responsive, modern interfaces; purposeful animation; mobile/tablet/desktop; screenshot loops for visual verification; fix oversized text, spacing, contrast, weak layout.

seo-boss.name: SEO Boss
seo-boss.responsibilities: Websites: metadata, structure, headings, performance, accessibility, image optimization, CWV-style issues, schema, indexability. Non-web: performance, discoverability, documentation clarity, runtime efficiency.

security-boss.name: Security Boss
security-boss.responsibilities: Keys/env vars/auth/webhooks/input validation/injection/unsafe logs/exposed secrets/production safety; no key ever committed; .gitignore + .env.example hygiene; strong reasoning model — high risk.

skill-boss.name: Skill Boss
skill-boss.responsibilities: Maintain the global skill registry; attach default skills to agents permanently; project-type bundles auto-attach; report missing skills + safe fallback; validate skill bundle + model match the agent's real task.

search-boss.name: Search Boss
search-boss.responsibilities: Approved search/research tools for current info; facts + sources + references; no hallucination; competitor/design/SEO/market research on request; source-grounded model.

build-boss.name: Build Boss
build-boss.responsibilities: Implement the actual code changes; follow architecture; clean, maintainable, tested code; never bypass QA/tests; coding-capable model only.

integration-boss.name: Integration Boss
integration-boss.responsibilities: NVIDIA Build/NIM, n8n, webhooks, Gmail, calendars, databases, payments; retries, timeouts, clear errors, fallbacks; clean documented config.

docs-boss.name: Docs Boss
docs-boss.responsibilities: Docs, setup instructions, architecture notes, env-var guides, final reports; simple language; exact commands; cheap/fast model unless complex architecture/security content.

specialistAgents._doc: 2026-09-26 (laptop re-audit D column: '7 specialist agents unregistered' — registry/model map listed 12 of 19 real .claude/agents/*.md files). OPTIONAL, domain-specific specialist agents — real agent-md files, dispatched directly by Boss/Head Chef when a work package needs this exact domain (Electron, payments, MCP, ML, data science) or on explicit request (verify-boss is the DEFAULT verifier per work package since GOAT 2026-10-06; codex-reviewer is an opt-in second opinion). Deliberately kept OUT of the `agents` map above: that map's exact count of 12 is a hard invariant several tools anchor on (e.g. nvidia-provider.test.cjs's 'agent registry has the 12 permanent Bosses'), and forge-certify.cjs's loadProjectAgentNames() already treats these as real on-request specialists proven by their own agent-md file, not by a registry row. Each entry here follows the SAME contract as a permanent Boss (permanent name + clear role + model assignment + self-review duty), added HERE template-first, then synced.

data-scientist.responsibilities: Exploratory data analysis to statistical modeling with rigorous validation; always attaches honest uncertainty/confidence labels; never fabricates a metric or claims certainty. Dispatched for prediction/data-analysis work packages.

codex-reviewer.name: Codex Reviewer

verify-boss.name: Verify Boss
verify-boss.role: Default verifier per work package (GOAT) + independent re-executor
verify-boss.responsibilities: GOAT routing (2026-10-06): the DEFAULT verifier after every work package — runs the checks from Head Chef's triage scaled to risk and replies PASS/FAIL with evidence; a FAIL triggers exactly one escalation step (FORGE_MODEL_ROUTING.json → escalation). Re-runs the exact build/test/health-check command a Boss claims passed, from a cold read of the diff, and reports the literal exit code. Read+execute-only — can re-run a claim but can never edit the evidence it verifies.

scribe.name: Scribe
scribe.responsibilities: WP-7b (run forge-2026-10-09-forge-core-overhaul, audit SCRIBE-F8): keeps every owner instruction verbatim (secrets scrubbed) as a tracked item R-n via forge-scribe.cjs — classifies it, links it to work packages, and reports open and done-but-unacked items for one batched owner question. Changes scribe state ONLY through forge-scribe.cjs; never edits project files (exec-reviewer class, no Write/Edit). Dispatched by the Lead (not Boss) only for a multi_ask prompt (3+ asks), end-of-run reconciliation, or a resume with 20+ open items; the normal path needs no LLM call. GOAT quick route (sonnet/low).

scribe-acker.name: Scribe-acker
scribe-acker.role: Owner-delegated acceptor of routine scribe items (NL: Accepteerder)
scribe-acker.responsibilities: Owner R-0233 (2026-11-11): the owner no longer acks routine scribe items by hand. Runs forge-scribe.cjs autoack under the recorded delegation owner-R-0233 while config scribe-autoack is on: acks done items whose evidence re-verifies in a run that is not red and confirms carry-over proposals that carry a reason; holds questions, unclassified, hard-gate and owner-decision items and missing or red evidence for the owner, and reports them as the one batched owner question. Never cancels, supersedes, answers, classifies or reopens; never acks with --prompt. Changes scribe state ONLY through forge-scribe.cjs autoack (exec-reviewer class, no Write/Edit). The UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks run the same autoack without an LLM call; the Lead dispatches this agent at end-of-run reconciliation. GOAT quick route (sonnet/low).
